title: Investigation of short- and long-term therapy outcome in treatment of thrombotic microangiopathies – retrospective anonymized data collection.
summary: Patients at the LMU University Hospital diagnosed with thrombotic microangiopathy between 2012 and 2025 will be included in this study. The progression of the disease under new treatment options (e.g., caplacizumab, eculizumab, ravulizumab, B-cell depletion) will be compared with the current standard therapy (plasmapheresis, steroid therapy).
conditions: thrombotic microangiopathy (TTP, M31.1; aHUS, D59.3; other)
